1.sahih_international: Woe to every scorner and mocker
1.yusuf_ali: Woe to every (kind of) scandal-monger and-backbiter,
1.muhammad_sarwar: Woe to every slanderer and backbiter
1.mohsin_khan: Woe to every slanderer and backbiter.

2.sahih_international: Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it.
2.pickthall: Who hath gathered wealth (of this world) and arranged it.
2.yusuf_ali: Who pileth up wealth and layeth it by,
2.shakir: Who amasses wealth and considers it a provision (against mishap);
2.mohsin_khan: Who has gathered wealth and counted it,
2.arberry: who has gathered riches and counted them over

3.sahih_international: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.
3.pickthall: He thinketh that his wealth will render him immortal.
3.yusuf_ali: Thinking that his wealth would make him last for ever!
3.shakir: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.
3.muhammad_sarwar: thinking that his property will make him live forever.
3.mohsin_khan: He thinks that his wealth will make him last forever!
3.arberry: thinking his riches have made him immortal!

4.sahih_international: No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.
4.pickthall: Nay, but verily he will be flung to the Consuming One.
4.yusuf_ali: By no means! He will be sure to be thrown into That which Breaks to Pieces,
4.shakir: Nay! he shall most certainly be hurled into the crushing disaster,
4.muhammad_sarwar: By no means! They will be thrown into hutamah.
4.mohsin_khan: Nay! Verily, he will be thrown into the crushing Fire.
4.arberry: No indeed; he shall be thrust into the Crusher;

5.sahih_international: And what can make you know what is the Crusher?
5.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Consuming One is!
5.yusuf_ali: And what will explain to thee That which Breaks to Pieces?
5.shakir: And what will make you realize what the crushing disaster is?
5.muhammad_sarwar: Would that you knew what hutamah is!
5.mohsin_khan: And what will make you know what the crushing Fire is?
5.arberry: and what shall teach thee what is the Crusher;

6.sahih_international: It is the fire of Allah, [eternally] fueled,
6.pickthall: (It is) the fire of Allah, kindled,
6.yusuf_ali: (It is) the Fire of (the Wrath of) Allah kindled (to a blaze),
6.shakir: It is the fire kindled by Allah,
6.muhammad_sarwar: It is a fierce fire created by God

7.sahih_international: Which mounts directed at the hearts.
7.pickthall: Which leapeth up over the hearts (of men).
7.yusuf_ali: The which doth mount (Right) to the Hearts:
7.mohsin_khan: Which leaps up over the hearts,

8.sahih_international: Indeed, Hellfire will be closed down upon them
8.pickthall: Lo! it is closed in on them
8.yusuf_ali: It shall be made into a vault over them,
8.shakir: Surely it shall be closed over upon them,
8.mohsin_khan: Verily, it shall be closed in on them,

9.muhammad_sarwar: in its long columns of flames.
9.mohsin_khan: In pillars stretched forth (i.e. they will be punished in the Fire with pillars, etc.).
